chars.WIFE: WIFE: a young Moroccan woman in her early twenties wearing a dusty-pink knitted hijab and a long mustard-yellow cardigan over a cream long dress
chars.HUSBAND: HUSBAND: a young Moroccan man about 26 with short curly black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a bottle-green hoodie and black joggers
chars.MOTHER: MOTHER: a plump Moroccan woman in her fifties in a light blue house djellaba and a white headscarf
chars.BROTHERS: BROTHERS: two young Moroccan men, one in a red football jersey, one in a grey tracksuit

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Modest working-class Moroccan apartment living room with low banquette sofas and patterned cushions. WIFE sits quietly in the corner of the sofa, head down, secretly writing in a small floral notebook, shielding it with her hand. HUSBAND stands in the doorway behind, leaning, watching her with a curious raised eyebrow. Warm evening light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Narrow Moroccan apartment hallway. HUSBAND peeks around the corner frowning, suspicious and puzzled, while in the background WIFE walks away silently, hugging a small floral notebook to her chest.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Small Moroccan kitchen with blue tiles and a tagine on the stove. WIFE kneads bread dough on a round wooden board next to MOTHER, who smiles at her warmly and pats her shoulder. WIFE smiles shyly, silent.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan family dinner around a low round table with a big tagine and bread. BROTHERS laugh loudly and gesture, HUSBAND laughs with them, while WIFE sits silent at the edge, eyes down, not talking.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Simple Moroccan bedroom at dusk. WIFE sits cross-legged on the bed writing intensely in a small floral notebook, her arm curled protectively around the page, a focused secretive expression.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room. BROTHERS tease HUSBAND, one twirling a finger next to his own temple with a big grin, the other laughing and pointing. HUSBAND shrugs awkwardly with a half smile.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Dark Moroccan bedroom at night lit by a small bedside lamp. HUSBAND lies awake on his back, eyes open, staring sideways at a small floral notebook on the nightstand, while WIFE sleeps turned away beside him.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, dim lamp light. HUSBAND crouches beside the bed, carefully opening the small floral notebook, eyes wide and shocked by what he reads, while WIFE sleeps in the bed behind him unaware.
